global_decision_rules.protocol_failure: Change evaluation transport or output protocol only; do not change dataset difficulty.
global_decision_rules.primary_below_0_35_or_l1_below_0_60: Treat as a floor effect; add no difficulty and reduce one diagnosed burden in L1 or L2.
global_decision_rules.primary_0_45_to_0_65_and_curve_pass: Freeze content difficulty and proceed to cross-family Pilot20 verification.
global_decision_rules.primary_above_0_65: Modify only mechanisms linked to correctly answered eligible items; preserve all factual gold and lower levels.
global_decision_rules.adjacent_drop_below_0_08: Change only the upper member of the weak adjacent pair after structured error analysis.
global_decision_rules.curve_inversion: Change only the inverted upper level; do not globally add length or distractors.

L1-L2.description: Require the same-event accepted observation to satisfy both source authenticity and an incident-specific version or lock key; each key is stated in a separate natural span.
L1-L2.required_proof_effect: The proof graph must contain distinct necessary paths for target binding and controlling-source selection.
L1-L2.activation: Only if the valid L1-L2 factual-field drop is below 0.08 and L2 accuracy is above its frozen band.

L2-L3.description: Add a parallel incident with the same rule family and overlapping fact vocabulary; resolution requires the existing player, over and time identity chain rather than lexical similarity.
L2-L3.required_proof_effect: The accepted facts must remain reachable only from the target incident's identity path; no new answer cue is permitted.
L2-L3.activation: Only if the valid L2-L3 factual-field drop is below 0.08 and errors are dominated by cross-incident binding rather than protocol failure.

L3-L4.description: Compose revision precedence with a pre-lock timing condition so that neither metadata comparison alone selects the controlling observation.
L3-L4.required_proof_effect: Both ordered-source predicates must be necessary and connected to the authority node; removing either must leave source selection unresolved.
L3-L4.activation: Only if the valid L3-L4 factual-field drop is below 0.08 and authority or order errors dominate.

L4-L5.description: Select an atomic upstream fact whose counterfactual changes delivery validity, dismissal eligibility and at least two run-ledger fields while preserving a unique evidence chain.
L4-L5.required_proof_effect: The factual and counterfactual records must share identity and authority evidence but require recomputation through multiple interacting cricket rules.
L4-L5.activation: Only if the valid L4-L5 factual-field drop is below 0.08 or counterfactual performance plateaus, without a floor effect.

post_mutation_gates: fresh Sentinel5 before any Pilot20 claim
